name: Dry Eye Decoder
tagline: Modern Dry Eye Diagnosis and Practice Building
description: A 15-episode series covering the full dry eye spectrum — meibomian gland dysfunction, aqueous deficiency, in-office treatments, and building a dry eye service line.

episodes.title: The TFOS DEWS II Definition: Why It Changed Dry Eye Practice
episodes.description: The updated DEWS II definition (loss of homeostasis of the tear film), the two main mechanisms, and the diagnostic algorithm.

episodes.title: Meibomian Gland Dysfunction: The Leading Cause of Evaporative Dry Eye
episodes.description: Expressing the meibomian glands, grading secretion quality, the role of meibography, and why MGD drives 80% of dry eye.

episodes.title: Aqueous-Deficient Dry Eye: Sjögren Screening and Lacrimal Gland Disease
episodes.description: When to screen for Sjögren syndrome (OSS, ANA, SSA/SSB), the sicca triad, and the systemic workup for aqueous deficiency.

episodes.title: Diagnostic Tests: TBUT, Schirmer, Osmolarity, and MMP-9
episodes.description: How to perform each diagnostic test, the cutoffs (TBUT <10s, Schirmer <5mm, osmolarity >316), and how they complement each other.

episodes.title: Meibography and LipiView: Imaging the Meibomian Glands
episodes.description: Interpreting meibography (gland dropout, tortuosity, gland shortening), the LipiView interferometry, and what the images tell the patient.

episodes.title: Artificial Tear Formulations: Choosing the Right Drop for the Right Patient
episodes.description: The difference between preserved and preservative-free, lipid-based vs aqueous, and matching the formulation to the dry eye subtype.

episodes.title: Lid Hygiene and Warm Compresses: Evidence for the Basics
episodes.description: Why lid hygiene works for MGD, the temperature and duration for effective warm compresses, and building patient compliance.

episodes.title: Omega-3 Supplementation: The DREAM Trial and the Evidence
episodes.description: The DREAM trial findings, the difference between EPA and DHA, and how to counsel patients honestly about expectations.

episodes.title: Punctal Plugs: Indications, Types, and Complications
episodes.description: When to place plugs (after dry eye control), collagen vs silicone, the lower-then-upper approach, and managing epiphora and extrusion.

episodes.title: Prescription Dry Eye Drops: Cyclosporine, Lifitegrast, and Perfluorohexyloctane
episodes.description: The mechanism of each prescription drop (Restasis, Xiidra, Miebo), the onset of action, and how to sequence them with other therapies.

episodes.title: IPL and Thermal Pulsation: In-Office Procedures for MGD
episodes.description: How intense pulsed light treats MGD (vascular, anti-inflammatory), the LipiFlow thermal pulsation protocol, and expected outcomes.

episodes.title: Scleral Lenses and PROSE for Severe Dry Eye and Ocular Surface Disease
episodes.description: When a scleral lens becomes the treatment for severe dry eye (SJS, GvHD), the PROSE device, and fitting considerations.

episodes.title: Dry Eye After Refractive and Cataract Surgery: Prevention and Treatment
episodes.description: Why LASIK induces dry eye (corneal nerve section), the post-cataract dry eye, and the pre-op dry eye optimisation protocol.

episodes.title: Systemic Causes Beyond Sjögren: Thyroid, Rosacea, and Autoimmune
episodes.description: The ocular rosacea signs, thyroid eye disease dryness, and the broader autoimmune workup when dry eye is severe or atypical.

episodes.title: Building a Dry Eye Service Line: Protocols, Pricing, and Patient Flow
episodes.description: How to structure a dry eye clinic — the diagnostic workflow, the treatment ladder, the fee schedule, and patient education materials.
